notes.title: Update Game Engine Version
notes.notes:
Game Engine: Godot 4.4 => Godot 4.5

Added auxiliary lines to make it easier to distinguish the line being operated.

notes.title: Increase to object falling speed by user control.
notes.notes:
By using the down input, the object will fall to a suitable location in a short time.
This is a change to improve user experience.

And, Add new Animation.

notes.title: Update Setting UI
notes.notes: [p]When changing settings with a controller (or keyboard), the currently selected item will now be displayed with a yellow border.[/p][p]Also, if there are items that cannot be changed due to other settings, the selection of those items will be skipped.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45297801/bcf247c843d2d852d39bb18c808c7880efe5a543.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Visual Effects Updates
notes.notes: Updated visual effects when removing blocks

notes.title: display enemy health bar.
notes.notes:
display enemy health bar.
This change will increase the number of attacks against enemies.

notes.title: Minor fixes
notes.notes: Optimization of judgment for move blocking.

notes.title: Score Multiplier
notes.notes: [p]Add Score Multiplier System.[/p][p]This is a measure to shorten the time of one play when aiming for a high score.[/p][p][/p][p][url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45297801/a2fe70454da47edbc2a23db087a6945556de986e.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45297801/fb2183d192a8139a9c0ac60d075d76507248fe2b.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p] Your score multiplier can be seen below, under the score.[/p][p]If you encounter a high-level rare monster, the score multiplier will increase even more.[/p]

notes.title: Fixed block operation end judgment
notes.notes:
Fixed block operation end judgment.
If block operation can not move for left or right, the block operation will be end.
This fixes a bug where sound effects would play without moving blocks.

Improved display when ranking information can not received.

notes.title: Changed the layout of the title screen
notes.notes:
Changed the layout of the title screen.
Added images and How To Play.

notes.title: Minor fixes
notes.notes: Changes to enemy encount conditions, and Internal changes for the future.

notes.title: change the draw order of objects
notes.notes:
Changed the z-order of object.
Animation effect go to background of pazzle symbole.

notes.title: few bug fix
notes.notes: few bug fix

notes.title: Add Frame rate setting
notes.notes: Add Frame rate Setting, and few peformance update.

notes.title: Increased speed when moving blocks downwards
notes.notes:
For comfortable gameplay, Increased speed when moving blocks downwards.
Also, The speed of naturally falling blocks has also been adjusted.

notes.title: Minor fix for resource
notes.notes: Remove unnecessary resources.

notes.title: Revision of combo bonus
notes.notes:
Changed the formula for calculating bonus scores for combos.
Larger chains will allow you to earn larger bonuses.

There are few combo bonuses that can be easily created.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45297801/547069255bd222d5e4618ab67ed5094089575bca.png[/img]

The larger the combo, the greater the score multiplier.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45297801/1b58a3efff7864b04e6c5948a0f009b84775cdb3.png[/img]

notes.title: Add chaining animations
notes.notes:
After connecting four of the same symbols, we added a animation to make it easier to see that adjacent different symbols are part of chaining.

For example, the image below:
Symbols on the adjacent scrolls are engulfed in flames, when the flame symbols are connected and disappear.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45297801/4d6a8026702d077c21344b4406960933312016aa.png[/img]

notes.title: bugfix: bonus notifications
notes.notes: Fixed a bug where bonus notifications were not brought to the top order.

notes.title: Update: Screen layout
notes.notes:
The screen layout has been revised and the animation area has been split into left and right.
Also, the bonus display has been updated to make it easier to see that the score is boosted by the bonus.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45297801/11637a4c8c6fd1e7f7a35ccc4a067f94694be556.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45297801/25b4f173c07bd56d512bd687091ecddd46e5cb65.png[/img][/url]

The displayed message and score will change depending on the chain state.

notes.title: Resource Management Update
notes.notes: To prevent delays in rendering updates, some resources are now loaded in the background.

notes.title: Add start countdown time (3sec)
notes.notes: Displayed 3 second countdown timer when the GamePlay starts.

notes.title: Added chain bonus system
notes.notes:
For every 3 or more chains, an additional 100 points will be added to your score. The added chain bonus will be displayed near the score in the bottom right of the game screen.
